content:
Marta R.: Quick sync - drafting the peering cutover dry-run playbook. Goal: zero app-visible downtime for tenant peering flips.
Eli W.: Key constraints: preserve existing NAT mappings for live TCP flows and avoid routing oscillation during dual-path windows.
Samir K.: Tie-breaker idea: existing established TCP flows stay on original path. New connections follow route-stability heuristic.
Priya V.: Route-stability: route_flap_count with 10s decay, degrade if >=3 within 60s. Use that to prefer relay.
Marta R.: Cutover modes: `mirror` (duplicate outbound, no duplicate client ACKs), `dual-path` (primary+fallback), and `drain` (move new conns only).
Eli W.: Example operator command:
```
PATCH /api/v1/tenants/9001
{"mode":"dual-path","preferred":"peer","revert_secs":300}
```
Samir K.: Mirror mode needs dedupe. Emit header `X-Cutover-UUID` and aggregator treats same UUID within window as single billable request.
Priya V.: Observability: emit events cutover.started, cutover.route_degraded, cutover.srcip_violation. Dashboards with peer vs relay error rates.
infra-bot: relay-autoscaler: group-relay-7 scaled 6->18 in 12m during test traffic replay.
Marta R.: Prewarm rule: if scheduled cutover, prewarm relay to max(2x baseline, min-capacity) for 15m before start to avoid autoscaling thrash.
Eli W.: KV cache: writes in mirror/dual-path must be applied with `kv_sync=best_effort|sync_quorum` option. Sync mode default to best_effort for perf.
Samir K.: Connection pinning: keep TCP/NAT mapping pinned for 120s after path switch. Implement at proxy egress.
Priya V.: Rollback triggers: >1% error spike over 5m, src_ip_preserved=false >0.1% sampled, autoscale thrash (>=2 scale ops in 5m).
Marta R.: Owners: I'll write RFC + runbook. Eli will implement operator CLI and dry-run flag. Samir owns sampler/dedupe and pinning. Priya will add dashboard and rollback automation. Raj (cc) will run traffic replay.
Eli W.: I'll add `--dry-run` that emits simulated events; no billing tags applied.
Samir K.: We'll add test tenants: acme-qa, acme-staging, enterprise-canary-3.
Marta R.: Dry-run scheduled Wed 09:30 PT (30m). Deliverables before run: runbook, operator CLI, simple smoke tests, prewarm script, SNAT reservation helper.
Priya V.: OK, I'll prepare dashboards and an automated verification sweep for src_ip_preserved and kv_cache_consistent.
Marta R.: If no objections I'll post RFC today and tag eng-platform + infra.
Eli W.: :thumbsup:
Samir K.: +1
Priya V.: :+1:
